# Ordinance No. 04, Series of 2004

**Taxation of Electrical Posts Rented by Commercial Establishments**

## Summary

This ordinance levies a tax on every electrical post rented by commercial establishments within the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon. It mandates the Engineering Office to inventory rented posts, requires the municipal treasurer to inform agencies about the tax, and imposes a penalty for unpaid taxes. The ordinance takes effect immediately upon approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Every electrical post rented by any commercial establishment in the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon shall be taxed at the rate of Twenty Pesos (₱20.00) per annum in the town proper.
2.  **Section 2.** The Engineering Office of the Local Government should make an inventory of all electrical posts rented by any commercial establishment in the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon and submit total number to the treasurers office.
3.  **Section 3.** The municipal treasurer shall inform all concerned agency about the tax due as provided in Section 1.
4.  **Section 4.** The Municipal Treasurer is hereby authorized to collect tax due to the municipality.
5.  **Section 5.** Failure to pay the said amount shall merit a penalty of 50% of the total amount unpaid per annum.
6.  **Section 6.** Any ordinance there of which is inconsistent with the provision of this ordinance is hereby repealed accordingly.
7.  **Section 7.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
